Chapter 7163: Maternal Power, Nest Of Life

Chapter 7163: Maternal Power, Nest of Life

“Apex Beast, Royal Skykiller!” Skykiller shouted the technique’s name, grasping the heightened powers of all beings.

At this point, a mortal could send a dragon flying; an insect could swallow a continent... Trillions and trillions of forces gathered on a single being.

“This has to be the peak of apex power.” Primordial and celestial immortals commented while shuddering.

“Can’t get any better than this.” One celestial immortal with apex power took a deep breath.

In a hidden realm of darkness, a colossal monster with eight claws opened its eyes and assumed a state of alert.

“This must be Hidden Immortal’s true power, no wonder why this being is on the same level as Octopus.” Another celestial immortal knew the attacker without being present at the battlefield.

A fully let-go being, independent from this world, also remarked: “Amazing, cannot defeat this within the confines of apex power.”

Li Qiye faced the full force of Skykiller and all worlds, all contained within the spear tip. It extinguished everything, potent enough to eradicate celestial immortals.

“Bam!” Celestial immortals could see as everything around Li Qiye was extinguished; he raised his hands and conjured an eternal force to block it.

“How can this be?!” Spectators found this unimaginable.

“Die!” Skykiller had absolute confidence in this move, thinking that even Octopus and An Ran would be injured. Only the high heaven might be able to block it successfully.

“Nest of Life, maternal power!” Skykiller continued, melting the body into the nest’s dimensions.

As the two became one, Skykiller’s power surged again. The nest then took the form of colossal bone wings. Worlds and inhabitants modeled after Heavenrealm manifested into reality.

“Rumble!” He became a god of creation just like the high heaven. A celestial immortal with apex power couldn’t have endured the nest’s power. However, Skykiller took it in just fine due to his Royal Bloodlines.

“Originless!” Skykiller delivered the most dreadful blow.

“Is this on the same level as the avatar’s slash?” One celestial immortal gasped.

“Boom!” This move aimed to erase Li Qiye’s rivers of time, making it as if he had never disappeared in this world. His defenses, along with his origin, were erased from existence.

This erasure could only be possessed by the high heaven, not cultivators.

“Everything’s erased.” Someone commented.

“Hidden Immortal, the strongest beneath the heaven.” One celestial immortal said.
